notes: BACK TO BASICS. soundLAB now ALWAYS opens as the practice/theory app — clean tabs, no studio clutter (the capture dot and studio controls live only behind the Studio button; everything DAW is still one tap away, untouched). THE SYNTH IS AN INSTRUMENT NOW: a Synth pill sits right in the Instrument tab — the full playable keyboard locked to the Studio's MPE presets, with chords/arp and all input methods. And NEW: 1/4-INCH TONE-IN (Settings > Audio devices) — plug your guitar into the selected audio input and the notes you play light up every instrument page (fretboard positions, keys, guide mode) exactly like a MIDI keyboard; detection-only, low-confidence frames discarded. Keyboard, MIDI and guitar-in now all feed the same pipeline. NOTE: this update is live on web/desktop/PWA immediately; the Android APK build lags one release.
